final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.av
